explanation: Matches the 'in particular' question on erdosproblems.com/232 (is m₁ ≤ 1/4?) with the ACMVZ23 positive answer. m₁ is the supremum of upper densities (limsup over origin-centred balls) of measurable unit-distance-avoiding planar sets, which is well defined: nonempty and bounded by 1. Formal proof linked.
